create_table_visualizer: create a TableVisualizer instance to visualize table cells, rows, and columns on document page images
build_table_visualization_params: build TableVisualizer.Params with custom colors and visibility flags for cells, rows, and columns
run_table_cell_visualization: run table cell visualization to draw colored rectangles over individual table cells on a page image
run_table_row_column_visualization: run table row and column visualization to draw bounding boxes over table rows and columns
get_document_table_visualization: get a DoclingDocument visualization with table overlays drawn on each page image by page number
